text:
Anika: Morning — kicking off a short thread to lock the SI mentor kickpack and certification rubric. Goal: ensure training content, HW/software pack, and marketplace blurbs are synchronized before we open registration. ETA: packs ready by Sep 6, trainers certified Sep 8-10.

Carlos: Quick checklist idea: pack inventory, onboarding image checksum, one-pager w/ contact, proctoring flow link, and embargoed announcement copy.

Rhea: Add evaluation rubric to that list. We need pass/fail thresholds + examples. Prefer a scoring matrix (functional bringup 40, demo walkthrough 30, quiz 30). Recommend 75% passing.

Omar: Logistics note: custom power modules for APAC take extra customs paperwork. We should split APAC vs EU/NA manifests and mark items that require ESD packaging.

lisa-legal: FYI — partners who requested co-branded collateral also require a review of the blurb 7 days prior to public announcement. Share drafts to legal@redwood with subject "SI-Pack Blurb Review".

Anika: Drafting the scoring matrix now. Proposed fields:
- Functional bringup (0-40): hardware POST, network, driver/firmware check.
- Demo walkthrough (0-30): end-to-end sample prompt, model response sanity checks, latency smoke test.
- Quiz (0-30): short multiple choice + 1 config write exercise.

Carlos: Can we make the quiz auto-graded for MC and manual review for the config write? That speeds certing. Also save rubric in /training/si/cert-rubric-v1.md (internal repo).

Rhea: Yes — auto-grade MC, manual for config. Passing logic: if MC >= 70% and total >= 75% => pass. If config write fails, allow one resubmit within 7 days.

marketing-bot: [reminder] Please attach partner logos as 1024px PNGs. Deadline for creative assets: Sep 1.

Anika: For the pack contents I'm proposing: RDW-SI-KIT-v2 (compute tray x1), RDW-SW-IMG-v3 (USB + signed checksum), RDW-ONEPGR-v1, RDW-PORTCARD-v1. Include return shipping label and RMA instructions.

Omar: Can we also include a small printed troubleshooting cheat sheet? Last cohort had a lot of "can't ssh" questions.

Carlos: Good idea — include basic commands and the `lab-provision` snippet. Snippet below:
```bash
# mentor quickstart
redwoodctl provision --kit rdw-si-kit-v2 --role mentor
ssh mentor@{{kit-ip}}
sudo rdw-setup --verify
```

Rhea: Certification windows: propose region-aligned 48hr windows with fixed start times to avoid midnight runs. Example: APAC start 00:00 UTC, EMEA start 06:00 UTC, NA start 18:00 UTC. Each window open for 48 hours. Proctor signups in local time slots.

Anika: Agree. Also add a soft cutover for marketplace listing: we will enable the SI onboarding feature flag `si_onboard_v2` 48hrs before public announcement for partners to test. Share flag name with marketplace team.

lisa-legal: Flag naming looks fine. Ensure privacy note included in onboarding flow: "User data submitted during lab sessions is retained 14 days and deleted unless explicitly authorized." Add to legal review.

marketing-bot: [task] Draft embargo schedule created: partner review due Sep 1, creative final Sep 3, announcement Sep 8.

Omar: Shipping ops: I'll prepare two manifest templates (Intl, Domestic). Need final mailing addresses by Aug 30 to guarantee Sep 6 delivery.

Carlos: I'll own the training videos — plan: 3 short vids (hardware bringup, software image restore, walkthrough demo) + slides. Will upload to /training/si/videos and tag them with `si-2026-q3`.

Rhea: Also we should run a calibration session for graders on Sep 7 to ensure consistency. 1hr session, sample submissions for review.

Anika: Assigning action items:
- Carlos: training videos + upload (due Aug 25).
- Omar: manifests + shipping plan (due Aug 30).
- Rhea: finalize rubric + schedule grader calibration (due Sep 1).
- lisa-legal: blurb reviews + privacy text signoff (due Sep 1).
- Marketing: collect assets + lock embargo (marketing-bot deadline Sep 1).

marketing-bot: [note] Creative/PR needs partner one-liners and logos by Sep 1.

Omar: One blocker: a partner in LATAM requires additional power adapter spec. If any partner has atypical requirements, flag now.

Carlos: Noted — I'll survey partner contacts and surface exceptions by Aug 22.

Rhea: If graders need tools, we can spin a temporary reviewer role with read access to submissions and a grading UI. I'll request the IAM role after rubric finalization.

Anika: Thanks all. I'll compile final pack BOM and post it here when ready. Please add any last constraints. :sparkles:
